name: h3_eval_subset
complete_header:
private theorem h3_eval_subset (m : ℕ) (t : Point) :
    evaluate (subsetExpr m) t = oldSubsetSum m t :=
before_body:
simp [subsetExpr, evaluate, K, X, apply_ite, oldSubsetSum, h3_castCoord,
    Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
after_body:
rw [h3_subset_sum_canonical]
  norm_num only [subsetExpr, h3_eval_notation_add, h3_eval_notation_ite,
    evaluate, K, X, Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Fin.ofNat, Fin.succ] <;> first | rfl | ring1!

name: h3_eval_ascending
complete_header:
private theorem h3_eval_ascending (m : ℕ) (t : Point) :
    evaluate (ascendingExpr m) t = A (oldSubsetSum m t) :=
before_body: norm_num [ascendingExpr, evaluate, K, h3_eval_subset, A] <;> ring
after_body:
norm_num only [ascendingExpr, h3_eval_notation_add, h3_eval_notation_smul,
    evaluate, K, h3_eval_subset, A] <;> first | rfl | ring1!

name: h3_eval_descending
complete_header:

before_body: norm_num [descendingExpr, evaluate, K, h3_eval_subset, D] <;> ring
after_body:

name: h3_eval_R6

after_body:

name: h3_eval_common
complete_header:
private theorem h3_eval_common (k : Fin 37) (t : Point) :
    evaluate (h3CommonExpr k) t = commonSlack t k :=
before_body:
fin_cases k <;>
    norm_num [h3CommonExpr, commonSlack, evaluate, K, X,
      h3_eval_history, h3_eval_B3, h3_eval_R6, h3_eval_oppositeR6,
      h3_eval_D23, h3_eval_M8, h3_eval_opposite138, h3_eval_full,
      h3_eval_complement, h3_eval_total, mu, W] <;> ring
after_body:
fin_cases k <;>
    norm_num only [h3CommonExpr, commonSlack, h3_eval_notation_add, h3_eval_notation_sub,
      h3_eval_notation_smul, evaluate, K, X, h3_eval_history, h3_eval_B3, h3_eval_R6,
      h3_eval_oppositeR6, h3_eval_D23, h3_eval_M8, h3_eval_opposite138,
      h3_eval_full, h3_eval_complement, h3_eval_total, mu, W] <;> first | rfl | ring1!

name: h3_eval_branch
complete_header:
private theorem h3_eval_branch (i : Fin 12) (m : ℕ) (t : Point) :
    evaluate (h3BranchExpr i m) t = R6 t - oldPlane i m t :=
before_body:
simp [h3BranchExpr, oldPlane, evaluate, apply_ite, h3_eval_R6,
    h3_eval_ascending, h3_eval_descending]
after_body:
by_cases h : m ∈ leftMasks i
  · simp only [h3BranchExpr, oldPlane, if_pos h, h3_eval_notation_sub,
      h3_eval_R6, h3_eval_ascending]
  · simp only [h3BranchExpr, oldPlane, if_neg h, h3_eval_notation_sub,
      h3_eval_R6, h3_eval_descending]
